_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Uli mwine wa kufikisha {player_id} mu ndila ya Liar's Dice ya bantu {num_players}.
Nidhamu:
- Pa kufikisha kwako, unaweza kufanya:
  1) Kukamba kambu kipya na ngalwiko nyingi zaidi au uso wa juu zaidi (au zote mbili) kuliko kambu ya sasa; yaani '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Kuita kambu ya mwisho kwa kuandika '[Call]'.

Ukaita:
  - Ukiona kwamba kuheswa kwa uso wa thamani yote ya mabakuli ni chini ya kambu, mukambu wa mwisho ahuluke mabakuli moja.
  - Vinginevyo, mukaita ahuluke mabakuli moja.
Mwine wa kufikisha aliyefikisha mabakuli 0 ahuluke. Mwine wa kufikisha aliyesalia mwisho ahule.

board.new_round:
Nthawi mpya - Maboya yaliyosalia: {dice_summary}
Maboya yako ya sasa ni: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Muthu wakuvutisa {current_player_id} anaita! Wingi wa uso {face_value} ni {count}, ambao ni CHINI ya {quantity}.
Muthu wakuvutisa {loser_id} (mukwati wa mwisho) atapoteza maboya moja.
call.caller_loses:
Muthu wakuvutisa {current_player_id} anaita! Wingi wa uso {face_value} ni {count}, ambao ni >= {quantity}.
Muthu wakuvutisa {loser_id} (mwitaji) atapoteza maboya moja.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Wiza ulifanywa bila kuzingirwa kwa awali.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Kitendo hakijatambulika kama '[Bid: X, Y]' au '[Call]' chenji. Kitendo kilichowasilishwa: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Kwamba kwa wingi {new_quantity} ki ndikya kwa kuba kwa {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Kwamba kwa thamani ya uso {new_face_value} ki ndikya kwa kuba kwa {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Kombi ni sawa na komba ya sasa.
bid_reason.face_range: Uso wa thamani lazima uwe kati ya 1 na 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Muthu wakuvutisa {player_id} alikomeshwa na kukwata kusiwe.

outcome.win: Muthu wakuvutisa {winner} atashinda! Mpangilio wa mwisho: {final_ranking}
